name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring two-stage dynamic liquidations, accelerated early land scaling, strict Town Shop phase-gates, and a formalized fertilizer-integrated workforce routing.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Procures exact seed quantities for active shop demands within strict maturation phase-gates, routing all uncontracted surplus to open-market sales.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Executes two-stage dynamic batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus inventory at favorable market prices, unlocking fluid cash for reinvestment while preventing margin bleed and late-game inventory freezes.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into workforce scaling (up to 10 hands), accelerated early land expansion (up to 16-18 plots by Day 13), and hyper-fertilized recurring cash crops (Strawberries) for maximum multi-harvest yield compounding.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with cluster harvesting, immediate shed deposits, and formalized fertilizer application to maximize plot productivity and eliminate transit waste.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals > 0 ? max(4, n_animals * 3) : 0); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 180.0 and active_shop_demand > 0)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops. Dedicate 2-4 auxiliary plots for shop crops. Enforce strict seed phase-gates: ban Pumpkin seeds after Day 16, Tomatoes after Day 21, Carrots after Day 25. Cease all seed purchases after Day 26.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not hoard inventory speculatively for future unrevealed contracts. Never till mature Strawberry bushes for shop contracts. Do not buy shop seeds if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll.

attributes.guidance: Implement two-stage dynamic liquidation: Days 1-8 sell unreserved surplus at >= 0.85 * base_price. Days 9-28 tighten floor to >= 0.92 * base_price (relax to >= 0.88 if shed_used >= 50). Execute complete warehouse liquidation sweep across steps 700-716 of Day 30.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals > 0 ? max(4, n_animals * 3) : 0).

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0 and (hired_hands < 10 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce to 10 hands. Accelerate early plot expansion: 6-8 plots at hands >= 3 (Days 3-5), 10-12 plots at hands >= 5 (Days 6-8), and 16-18 plots at hands >= 8. Enforce strict land acquisition cutoff at Day 13. Dedicate 12-14 plots to untouchable, hyper-fertilized Strawberry perennials.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land after Day 13. Do not plant slow single-harvest crops unless explicitly demanded by an active town shop contract. Ensure persistent fertilizer procurement for all Strawberry plots.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands using priority sequence: 1) Cluster Harvest, 2) Immediate Shed Deposit (clearing worker inventory), 3) Apply Fertilizer to all unfertilized Strawberry plots, 4) Water dry crops, 5) Plant seeds, 6) Weed/Till. Workers must deposit full harvests before fetching fertilizer.
attributes.pitfalls: Never deprioritize watering below seed planting. Do not allow 1-crop transit cycles that waste worker steps. Ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain. Do not fetch fertilizer if worker inventory is full.
